question: Razorpay SDE intern, hiring manager/HR-style round. Reported questions: **why do you want to join Razorpay and what do you know about its recent work** (the interviewer wanted to see how well a student understands the company), a **deep dive into your projects with cross-questions on every line of the resume**, and, in the same interviews, a short discussion about your club roles and about AI basics such as RAG and LLMs if they appear on your resume.
lookingFor: Genuine research and interest in the company.
Depth of knowledge on every resume item you list.
Communication clarity and honesty about your contribution.
Ability to reason about trade-offs and improvements in your own project.
followUps: Walk me through the architecture of your best project.
What would you change in that project if you had one more month?
What is a payment gateway and what happens when a customer pays online?
Why is idempotency important in payment APIs?
